test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The government is distributing free food grains among the poor.

options.text: Free food grains are being distributed among the poor by the government.
Free food grains are distributed among the poor by the government.
Free food grains have been distributed among the poor by the government.
Free food grains were distributed among the poor by the government.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Free food grains are being distributed among the poor by the government.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is 'The government' and the object of the sentence is 'food grains'. 'among the poor' is a prepositional phrase.
 
• In the passive, the subject of the sentence becomes the object and the object of the sentence becomes the subject.
 
• Also, the verb of the sentence is 'is distributing' which is in the present continuous tense. So, in the passive voice, it becomes **'be (forms) +being+ V₃'**
 
• **Also, the prepositional phrase to be written after the main verb.**

**So the correct passive sentence is- ***Free food grains are being distributed among the poor by the government.*
